observations.summary: META_DESIGN_QUALITY_ONLY fixture baseline compatibility: synthetic persistence fixture using known P1 history; no new task or model evaluation.

model_opinions.assessment: Historical per-instance completion checks and external rendering fit the declared scope; production binding remains unknown.
Two render functions share a format boundary; this does not establish that all future variants fit.
The historical owner stayed unchanged for one format change; caller and recovery costs were not independently measured.
One predeclared JSON change stayed local; arbitrary future maintainability is unproven.
Thread stop and click ordering were outside scope; incremental Skill/Memory benefit and total cost remain unknown.

change_proposals.problem: Controlled requirement: retain design-quality opinions without treating them as verified task outcomes.
change_proposals.proposed_change: Use conditional feedback and a separately triggered system review; consider one guidance correction only with evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Ordinary and system records stay separate.
Opinions stay advisory; no automatic rule or serving change.
change_proposals.compatibility: Keep the existing query and report schemas.
change_proposals.rollback: No product mutation occurs in this development fixture.

missing_evidence: Synthetic manual input is not a real user review event.
No independent quality comparison, total cost, long-term gain, or Runtime defect is established.
